response.text:
I can’t watch your inbox or send messages in the background unless you create an automation I can trigger or explicitly authorize sending now. I can help two ways — pick one and answer the quick questions below:

Options
- A — I prepare everything now (draft reply + countersigned PDF attached) so you can send immediately when Amara replies. I’ll also prepare a 5:00 summary for you to send or review. No background monitoring or automatic sending.
- B — I give step-by-step code/instructions (Gmail filter + Google Apps Script or an automation with Zapier/Make) that will automatically detect Amara’s reply and send the countersigned PDF, plus schedule a 5:00 summary. You must install/run the automation (or grant the account access if your environment supports that).

Quick questions I need to proceed
1. Do you want automatic sending (Option B) or just prep + manual send (Option A)?  
2. Which recruiting inbox (email address) should be monitored? Which Amara (email address) is the expected sender?  
3. Please upload the countersigned PDF (or tell me if you want me to add your signature and provide the signature image/text).  
4. Exact reply text or tone you want sent to Amara (I can draft a concise template if you want).  
5. Confirm “5” — time zone and whether the summary should be emailed to you or posted here.  
6. Do I have permission to send on your behalf if we set up an automation? (If not, I’ll only prepare drafts/instructions.)

Sample outgoing reply (I can adjust)
Subject: Re: Offer
Body: Hi Amara — Thanks — please find the countersigned offer attached. Looking forward to next steps. Best, [Your Name]

Next step
Reply with your choice for Option A or B and answers to the questions above (and upload the PDF if available). I’ll prepare the draft/automation instructions as soon as you confirm.
